ELSE/WHERE

Privacy policy

Last updated November 25, 2026

Elsewhere is a trip planner: you save places you see in videos, put them on a map and into your days, and keep your booked flights in the same plan. This page explains what the app stores, who it shares it with, and how to delete it.

The short version

  • Elsewhere has no ads and no tracking, and it doesn't sell your data.
  • Your trips are saved on your phone. If you create an account, they're also saved to it so they're on every device you sign in on.
  • You can delete your account and everything saved to it from inside the app at any time.

What Elsewhere stores

  • Your account: your email address and a password. The password is stored hashed by our sign-in provider; we never see it.
  • Your trips: destinations, dates, plans, notes, flights you add, and ideas you save, including links you share into the app and the places attached to them.
  • Crash reports: when the app crashes, a report with the error, the app version and the phone model is sent so we can fix it. It doesn't include your trips, email or location.

Without an account, your trips stay only on your phone.

What happens when you use a feature

  • Searching for a place: what you type, and the area of your trip, are sent to Google Places through our server to find matches.
  • Sharing a link into the app: the link is sent to our server, which reads the post's public title and preview image to show it and to suggest places mentioned in it.
  • Looking up a flight: the flight number and date are sent to AeroDataBox through our server.
  • The map: maps are drawn by Apple Maps. Opening a place in Google Maps or a video in its app hands you over to that app or website.

Our server uses your IP address for a few minutes to limit how many searches one device can make, and doesn't keep it.

Who we share data with

Only the services that run the app, and only for the features above:

  • Supabase, which hosts accounts and saved trips
  • Vercel, which hosts our server
  • Google (Places), AeroDataBox (flights) and Apple (maps)
  • Sentry, which receives crash reports

We don't share or sell your data to anyone else, and we don't use it for advertising.

Deleting your data

In the app, tap your initial at the top right of the home screen, then Delete account. This permanently deletes your account and every trip and idea saved to it. Trips saved on a phone without an account are deleted when you delete them in the app or remove the app.

Children

Elsewhere isn't directed at children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their data.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, we'll update the date at the top. Questions or requests: [support email].
